lead: Where to park, who to look for, and how pick-up works.

parking.name: Middlefield Parking Lot
parking.how: Enter from Middlefield Road. Main lot, closest to our C, F, N and P wings.

parking.name: N. California Loop
parking.how: The half-circle driveway in front of the school. Walk east along the front to our wings.

parkingNote: Both are open on Sundays. Skip Staff Only spaces, and disabled spaces without a placard.
volunteers: At the lot entrance, directing cars
At the building doors, pointing to the right wing
Back out at 1:30 PM for pick-up
pickup: KG–Grade 8: a parent or guardian picks up from the classroom.
Youth Group may leave on their own.
Volunteers and security guards watch dismissal.
Optional Dhuhr prayer follows class, between the F and G wings.
closedCampus: Students can’t leave Greene during school unless a parent or guardian takes them, or Youth Group leaves with a chaperone.
greeneRules: No parking or stopping at red curbs.
No double parking. Pull fully into a space.
No drop-off at the small driveways by the C-Wing or behind the MPR.
Don’t open doors into the N. California bike lane.
Stay out of Bus Only zones.
sharing: We’re guests at Greene. If another event is on, like a swim meet, give them space and follow the volunteers.
